_what_this_is: A TEST FIXTURE, not a real cut list. Two pieces, made up, built 2026-11-05 for bin/kit_check.py.
_why_two: The bug this guards against is bin/clip_sense.py reading pull index 0 and nothing else when it is handed a batch with no --pull. A one piece fixture passes under that bug, so it proves nothing. The SECOND piece is the whole point of this file: a checker that reports only the first one fails on it.
_by_design: Piece B1 carries a reference to something outside itself, which clip_sense rates SERIOUS. Piece B2 carries nothing serious. A checker that collapses a batch to one verdict cannot tell them apart, and telling them apart is the product.

segments.text: Most people price their time by what they hope somebody will pay for it. That is backwards and it costs them a year. You price it by what the hour has to earn to cover the life you already decided on.
Go and do that sum tonight. That's your homework from the workbook.

problems: fixture: this piece exists so a per piece checker has something SERIOUS to attribute.

segments.text: Three hours a week is what a second offer costs you to run. If you cannot name those three hours, you do not have a second offer, you have a second worry.
So the first move is to find the three hours, and the money question waits until after you have. Losing a quarter to a thing you never staffed is the risk here.
